programme.title: Aanachandam
programme.desc: After an elephant saves him from an accident in childhood, Krishna becomes fond of elephants. His life changes when he decides to adopt Arjunan, a severely injured elephant.

programme.title: Koodevide
programme.desc: When her father's business suffers tremendous losses, Soorya, a determined girl, decides to step up to support her family.

programme.title: Nagarangalil Chennu Raparkam
programme.desc: Conflicts arise between the heir to a wealthy rural family and his overprotective father. However, hilarity ensues after the heir runs away to the city and gets involved in a series of mishaps.

programme.title: January Oru Orma
programme.desc: Raju, a tour guide who works at Kodaikanal, comes across Nimmi, a young girl, and falls in love with her. However, he soon starts uncovering secrets about his own birth and parents.

programme.title: Parking
programme.desc: A parking spot frays the relationship between two neighbours of different generations and world views. Soon, the two men find themselves in an escalating battle to have the space all to themselves.

programme.title: Kho-Kho
programme.desc: A physical education teacher named Maria decides to train the girls' school team in the sport of kho-kho and make her long-lost dream come true.

programme.title: Govindankutty Thirakkilanu
programme.desc: Govindankutty faces several obstacles after he inherits an ancestral property which often results in hilarious situations.

programme.title: Boyy Friennd
programme.desc: Ramesh's mother files a case against the home minister for molesting her. After a few days, the minister is found dead and people suspect Ramesh of murdering him.

programme.title: Excuse Me Ethu Collegila
programme.desc: Two friends, Ananthan and Appukuttan, set out to make a name for themselves. After losing their jobs, they venture into the real estate business and meet a girl who changes their lives.

programme.title: Iyer the Great
programme.desc: After surviving an accident, Soorya Narayana Iyer gains the power of clairvoyance and starts to foresee devastating incidents. He manages to impede the plans of the terrorists and a ruthless businessman, who vows to destroy his new enemy.

programme.title: Onnaman
programme.desc: Ravishankar, a street urchin, is looked after by Salim, a local don. After Salim's demise, Ravishankar rises to power and fights against an evil gangster.

programme.title: Thazhvaram
programme.desc: Balan and Raju's friendly relationship turns hostile when Raju murders Balan's wife and steals his hard-earned money. Thereafter, Balan decides to take revenge on Raju.

programme.title: Mark
programme.desc: When 18 children are abducted and found dead, Mark, a police officer, races to catch the criminals. With only 18 hours left, he must confront powerful foes and use unconventional tactics to succeed.

programme.title: Kali
programme.desc: Siddharth often has problems with his wife Anjali owing to his short temper. Things take an unexpected turn when they get involved with a gangster.

programme.title: Pakal Nakshatrangal
programme.desc: A filmmaker is found dead under mysterious circumstances. Years later, his son, Adi, a successful writer, digs into his past and tries to demystify the reason for his father's death.

programme.title: Winter
programme.desc: Fed up with the fast-paced city life, Ramdas and his wife decide to move to a quiet bungalow on the outskirts of the city. However, some strange happenings in the surrounding put their lives at risk.

programme.title: Female Unnikrishnan
programme.desc: Unni, who has a feminine voice, gets insulted by everyone in his neighbourhood. His life takes a turn when he gets married to a rich girl who is speech-impaired.

programme.title: Chakkikotha Chankaran
programme.desc: Pradeep marries Roshni without his family's consent. However, Roshni decides to move to her friend Shailaja's house with Pradeep, unaware that she is Pradeep's sister-in-law.

programme.title: Grama Panchayath
programme.desc: A young man tries to break away from his poverty-ridden life as a barber's son and hopes to study further. His father, however, refuses to send him away and threatens to commit suicide.

programme.title: Mayamayooram
programme.desc: Maheshwar struggles to raise Malu, his 5-year-old daughter, who holds him responsible for her mother's passing. Ganga attempts to mend the rift between them.

programme.title: Anubandham
programme.desc: The life of Sunandha, a poor widow, turns around after she starts a kindergarten with the help of her silent admirer. But things become complicated because of a tragic event.

programme.title: Jambulingam
programme.desc: Hardworking villager Jambulingam decides to fight against the oppressive landlord who exploits the local people. He stands against the barbarities and atrocities inflicted upon the villagers.

programme.title: Sankaranum Mohananum
programme.desc: Mohanakrishnan is a fashion photographer and his brother's ghost haunts him. He had died after being bitten by a snake, leaving behind a young wife.

programme.title: Pigman
programme.desc: After his thesis gets rejected and he gets expelled from his college, the idealistic Sreekumar is left with no choice but to take up menial jobs in a pigsty.

programme.title: Banking Hours 10 to 4
programme.desc: Three young men plot to rob a busy bank during its working hours. However, their plans go haywire after someone gets murdered in the bank premises, and they are accused of the crime.

programme.title: Nagaram
programme.desc: When Kochi's waste crisis spirals out of control, a group of crooked politicians scheme to dump the garbage in a village.

programme.title: Butterflies
programme.desc: Two friends, Prince and Sadasivan, agree to kidnap a girl for their friend, Pavithran. However, they find themselves in trouble when they abduct the wrong woman who then refuses to leave their house.

programme.title: Gulumaal: The Escape
programme.desc: Jerry Matthews, a con man, breaks away from his family. One day, he meets an ex-convict with whom he plans a daunting heist.

programme.title: Panchagni
programme.desc: Indira's life turns upside down after she gets a life sentence for murdering Avarachan, a landlord, who killed a young tribal woman after raping her.

programme.title: Nakshathra Tharattu
programme.desc: Sunil falls head over heels in love with Hema and marries her. However, things take a turn when they both discover that they are orphans.

programme.title: Simhasanam
programme.desc: Madhava Menon, a village chief who is highly respected for his integrity, faces trouble when a rival clan wreaks havoc in his village. Soon, his son decides to restore order.

programme.title: C.I. Mahadevan 5 Adi 4 Inchu
programme.desc: Mahadevan, a policeman, goes to a village to find the criminals behind a bomb blast. He is determined to unravel the mystery behind the tragedy and gets help from a crazy bunch of local policemen.

programme.title: Deepangal Sakshi
programme.desc: Rishi is a diligent collector who works honestly for the good of people. However, things take a turn after he draws the attention of corrupt politicians and businessmen who want to cause trouble.

programme.title: Vinayapoorvam Vidyadharan
programme.desc: Vidyadharan is a simple bank employee, but his meagre earnings are insufficient for his wife's extravagant lifestyle. Eventually, she costs him his job, forcing him to struggle.

programme.title: Nanma Niranjavan Srinivasan
programme.desc: Sreenivasan, a simple villager, is passionate about local theatre and hanging out with his friends. His life takes a turn when he applies for a job in the police department.

programme.title: Senior Mandrake
programme.desc: Kuttan strikes it rich after selling a cursed statue. However, his luck changes when the statue mysteriously returns, bringing chaos into his household.

programme.title: The Godman
programme.desc: Amarnath, a police officer, tries to settle a communal riot that has taken place among the fishermen. However, he faces many challenges as he strives to bring the criminals to justice.

programme.title: Ayitham
programme.desc: Bhama falls in love with Shankaran, but she is forced to marry another man. However, her life takes a turn when she discovers that her husband is already married.

programme.title: Nayika
programme.desc: Documentary filmmaker Aleena delves into the mysterious disappearance of the yesteryear Malayalam actress, Gracy, from the silver screen.

programme.title: Focus IV
programme.desc: Cop Bhanuchander dies at a guest house. Vijay Shanker investigates, suspecting murder. Vijay and Bhanuchander's wife, Suhasini, team up. Can they find the killer and bring justice?

programme.title: Joker
programme.desc: Babu perfects the art of being a clown and is promised the hand of Kamala, the circus owner's daughter. However, things take a turn when Sudheer Misra arrives in the troupe.

programme.title: Bhimaa
programme.desc: After some mysterious instances at a temple of historical significance, a detective visits the region to investigate and find out the truth behind the incidents.

programme.title: Comali
programme.desc: A long coma leaves Ravi disorientated in an unrecognisable world. However, he sets out on a journey to reclaim his past and adapt to a new reality.
